title: se-implementation-scratchpad-horizon-trust
content:
Customer: Horizon Trust (mid-size regional bank)
Owner: Priya Desai (SE) — daily scratchpad for implementation
Context: Private deployment behind customer VPC. Customer wants: dedicated capacity for peak windows, strict KMS/HSM key control, and fine-grained egress controls. POC target: ingest pipeline + chat support flow + embeddings for search.

Top-of-mind / current status:
- Signed NDA and SOW approved (legal). SOW start date: 2025-12-01.
- Security review kickoff 2025-11-26. Waiting on SOC docs from Horizon infosec.
- Network: customer prefers VPC peering to our Private control plane + on-prem worker pool for sensitive models.
- Model selection: start with redwood-7b-quant (q4_0_k_m) for chat, try 13b baseline if latency acceptable.
- Data residency: primary region us-west-2.

Immediate action items (today / this week):
- [ ] Upload Horizon RSA public key to onboarding portal (ticket HZN-1243) — due EOD 2026-02-28.
- [ ] Confirm KMS key alias and ARN with Horizon (ask security: Leah).
- [ ] Draft network diagram for VPC peering + NAT requirements — share with infra by 2026-03-03.
- [ ] Prepare canary traffic policy: route 10% to dedicated pool, 90% to hosted fallback. Note: customer wants deterministic routing for failover.
- [ ] Create initial roles + IAM policy for Horizon service account (least privilege).

Deployment notes / config snippets (copy to terraform later):
- Worker pool: private-onprem-01, GPU pool: A100-80GB x2 (burst) + T4 x4 for background batching
- Routing policy: {"priority":"dedicated","fallback":"hosted-compatible","latency_slo_ms":"150"}  <-- implement as rollout policy in console
- KV cache TTL: 600s for session affinity (reduces repeated prefix cost)
- Quantization profile: q4_0_k_m recommended for cost/latency; test with q2 and int8 if accuracy regressions acceptable

Network checklist (needed from customer):
- CIDR(s) for VPC peering (primary + transit)
- Allowed egress IPs for control-plane callbacks (we will provide list)
- Bastion host / jumpbox IPs if they want manual access to worker nodes
- VPN / Direct Connect details if they want private connectivity (preferred)

Security / compliance notes:
- KMS integration: customer requires CMEK with HSM-backed key; need key ARN + key policy that allows Redwood control-plane principal. Leah to validate key policy template.
- Audit logs: retention 7 years (customer asked). Need to confirm storage bucket + legal retention constraints.
- Data-at-rest: enable disk encryption on worker pool; ensure model artifacts are pulled from internal registry via signed tokens.

Testing plan + acceptance criteria:
- Stage 1 (baseline): deploy private control-plane + small worker pool; smoke test identity and routing; latency < 250ms 95th for 512 tokens.
- Stage 2 (load): 50 RPS sustained targeting dedicated pool for 1 hour; no errors > 0.1%.
- Stage 3 (failover): simulate dedicated pool outage, verify fallback to hosted-compatible model with < 200ms additional latency and no data leakage.

Open questions / risks:
- Q: Can Horizon accept 3rd-party hosted fallback for PII redaction path? If not, we must size dedicated pool bigger.
- Q: Does customer require model weights to be air-gapped (no external pull)? If yes, need offline transfer plan (sneakernet).
- Risk: KMS key policy iteration might block deployment for 1-2 sprints if legal wants changes.

Meeting notes (2026-02-27 call w/ Horizon infra):
- They prefer Direct Connect; billing approval pending.
- Asked about retention of raw request logs — explained we can redact tokens and keep request metadata only.
- They will provide network CIDRs and existing VPN certificates by next week.

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Priya: finish network diagram + push initial terraform skeleton (due 2026-03-03).
- Marco: validate worker pool sizing and cost estimate (due 2026-03-02).
- Leah: KMS key policy template + compliance checklist (due 2026-03-04).
- Samir: prepare demo script for canary failover (due 2026-03-05).

Quick notes / reminders:
- Use ticket HZN-1250 for all infra changes to keep audit trail.
- Keep convo about hosted fallback in private thread (Slack #se-horizon-trust).
- Bookmark: confluence page for implementation notes (linked above).

Dump of config ideas to copy into repo later:

priority: dedicated

# worker pool tags

Notes to self: keep this doc lightweight — transfer final copy to Confluence when we reach "in_review".

-- Priya
